_comment: Recommended per-PLUGIN settings, offered as an apply-or-skip substep of the guided walks' plugin layer and read by scripts/plugin-settings.js; /alfred-code:init applies the claude-hud row through scripts/hud-statusline.js, after the statusLine it gates. A plugin ships its own defaults; this catalog holds only the keys THIS stack has a reason to change, each with a `why` a user can weigh. Row shape: `verified` (the exact plugin version + file the keys were read from - a key the plugin does not read is a silent no-op, so never add one from memory), `scope` (`account` when the plugin's config file is account-level whichever scope the plugin was installed at), and `targets[]` - `file` (path relative to the ACCOUNT config dir: ~/.claude, or ~/.claude-<space> under a profile), `settings` (the object to deep-merge), `why` (per top-level key group), the optional `requires_path` (dotted path that must already exist in the target, else the target is skipped - a patch to a block the plugin's own setup writes must not invent that block), and the optional `chosen_by` (key -> another dotted path whose presence means the user already chose that key, so it is reported and kept). The script only ADDS missing keys by default: a value the user already chose is reported as a difference and kept unless they explicitly pick replace.

claude-hud.verified: claude-hud 0.12.1 - dist/config.js DEFAULT_CONFIG (key names + shipped defaults: every key below present), mergeConfig and migrateLegacyLayout (a legacy layout key migrated only while lineLayout is absent), commands/configure.md layout table (Compact = lineLayout compact + showSeparators false), dist/claude-config-dir.js getHudPluginDir (<config dir>/plugins/claude-hud) and README 'Auto-Refresh' (refreshInterval on the statusLine entry); first read on 0.8.0; 0.12.0 adds only display.showAgentEffort (default false, not set here); 0.12.1 changes none of these files

why.lineLayout: claude-hud's own Compact preset: one line under the prompt instead of the multi-line default, so the HUD costs the least terminal height in every session
why.showSeparators: the same preset: Compact, not Compact + Separators
why.display: the stack's own working surface, on screen: skills / MCP / agents / tools are what an alfred-code session actually runs (the same four analyze-usage.js reconstructs from the transcript afterwards), config counts say whether this project's rules and hooks really loaded, cost is the number the flow-vs-single benchmarks turn on, the effort level is pinned per seat and otherwise invisible after a runtime /effort, and the prompt-cache expiry decides whether a pause costs a full re-read
why.gitStatus: the git preferences' anti-split discipline: unpushed commits and the working-tree file counts are the two things the pre-commit checkpoint asks about

why.statusLine: Claude Code re-runs the statusline only on events (a message, /compact, a mode change, a rate-limit reset, a cache expiry), so every time-based field (usage reset countdown, session duration) freezes while a session is idle; claude-hud's README asks for a refreshInterval to keep them ticking, and 5s is the interval 0.8.0 suggested
